summary: Allbirds announced a pivot from footwear to "AI compute infrastructure", backed by a $50M deal, and plans to rename itself NewBird AI. The stock rose about 580% on the news. This is outside the 90-day window, but it changes who the company is and what it buys.

Allbirds is reported to have pivoted from footwear to AI servers after securing $50M in funding, which sparked a large stock rally. The headlines are undated and the article body wasn't retrieved, so the details are unverified.
A Proactive headline says Allbirds secured $50M in funding tied to the AI-server pivot. Investors, terms and date are not confirmed.

Allbirds, rebranded as Smartbird, appointed Nadia Carlsten as CEO and board member, replacing Joe Vernachio. A separate snippet says the company officially changed its corporate name and named a new CEO about 8 days before the snippet was captured.
Former Allbirds CEO Joe Vernachio has been named president of Sorel. The snippet only says '5 days ago' and gives no date.

Q2 2026 results were reported on Aug 18, 2026. Revenue was $2.76M against a consensus of about $29.5M, and EPS was -$1.39 (adjusted) or -$1.79 (GAAP). The tiny revenue figure suggests the footwear business has shrunk or been divested, but that is not confirmed.
The stock is volatile: it rose 33.7% on Oct 1, 2026 to about $3.49, then fell to about $2.36 by Oct 14. The next earnings date is estimated for around Nov 5, 2026.

Chobani launched La Colombe Matcha Lattes in three flavors: Vanilla, Strawberry and a third (probably classic matcha).
Chobani is bringing back Peppermint Mocha Coffee Creamer. It is also releasing Pistachio Chocolate Coffee Creamer as its fourth and final Flavor Drop of the year.
Chobani launched High Protein Drinks in 6 flavors with 20g or 30g of protein. The post's title mentions a $20M investment in a facility. The post is undated, so the timing is unconfirmed.

Chobani has open roles in Twin Falls (production supervisor, HTST operator), Philadelphia (procurement manager covering new product launches) and New York (eCommerce). These suggest continued manufacturing and supply chain hiring.

Chobani announced a $1.2B investment to take over Keurig Dr Pepper's 1.5M sq ft facility in Upper Macungie Township, PA. It is Chobani's first dairy operation in Pennsylvania. It is expected to create 900 jobs, with production starting in 2027 and more than 3B lbs of PA milk a year at full scale.

Chobani's Rome, NY plant expansion (Phase 1) is reported to need up to 2M lb of milk a day. PennLive reported a mid-summer 2027 start after $270M in upgrades. The company's cumulative US investment count is reported at $14.4B across 77 projects in 21 states.

Chobani is hiring for the new Pennsylvania plant (Director of Finance - Plant, Allentown). It also has open roles in procurement, innovation scientist, talent acquisition (including early-careers programs), and field sales. This points to a high-growth, high-headcount phase.
La Colombe Matcha Lattes launched online on Sept. 29, with a wider retail and cafÃ© rollout to follow.
Chobani is bringing back holiday creamers (Peppermint Mocha) and releasing a Pistachio Chocolate Flavor Drop. 2026 has also brought other new creamer flavors, such as Ube Sweet Cream.

summary: Chobani launched High Protein Drinks (20g or 30g protein, 6 flavors) alongside a $20M investment in new manufacturing. The source is an Instagram post, and no date is shown.
Chobani ran its annual 'Let's Eat Week' food-insecurity initiative, including a Philadelphia event that packed 2,200 food boxes with the mayor attending.

There is some negative local press. An SF Standard opinion piece says Chobani has gone quiet on plans for Anchor Brewing, which it bought more than two years ago. The Real Deal reported that the planned Chobani House in Manhattan 'remains conspicuously quiet'.

Clay raised a $115M Series D at a $7.1B valuation. Reuters, SiliconANGLE and others covered it. One social post says Wellington Management led the round, and Tracxn lists Wellington as lead with Sequoia, a16z, Meritech, DST, CapitalG and others participating.

Clay shipped a run of products over the summer. These include Account Research Agents (Jul 22), open-weight models in Claygent (Jul 16), an API and CLI (Jul 9), MCP for Reps in AI tools, and continuous TAM account discovery (Jul 28). It also launched targeted ad audiences with higher match rates (Aug 4).
Clay announced a $1M scholarship fund in September to train GTM engineers. CEO Kareem Amin is also scheduled to speak at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 on the rise of the GTM engineer.

Clay held its SCULPT 2026 conference with more than 2,000 attendees, up from 700 the year before. It presented a 'self-learning revenue engine' roadmap that includes Clay Workflows, a Knowledge Hub and an inbound SDR agent.
Intentsify announced a partnership with Clay to bring buyer intent data into Clay GTM workflows.
Cohere and Germany's Aleph Alpha signed a definitive merger agreement on 2026-09-16 at a reported $20B combined valuation. Sources disagree on whether it has closed (see notes).
Cohere said on 2026-10-15 that it signed a letter of intent to buy AISLE, a San Francisco AI cybersecurity startup. This is a non-binding LOI and I could only see the search snippet.
A funding tracker lists Cohere as being in talks to raise $2â€“3B at a reported valuation of about $20B (September 2026). The round is unconfirmed.
CEO Aidan Gomez called for a global AI safety body that includes China, as Cohere pushes to play a bigger international role.
Cohere is actively hiring go-to-market staff, including an Account Executive for SLED (West), which points to a push into US public-sector sales.

Cohere and AISLE announced a signed letter of intent for Cohere to acquire AISLE, which builds autonomous software-vulnerability discovery and remediation systems. Price and closing date were not disclosed, and the deal is not confirmed as completed.
Cohere launched North 2, its agentic AI platform. It adds admin cost and usage controls, support for rival vendors' models, cross-session memory, and air-gapped deployment.
Thales Canada signed a partnership with Cohere to build agentic AI for the Royal Canadian Navy's in-service support. No contract value was disclosed.
TD Bank committed up to $25M over three years to a strategic collaboration between its Layer 6 AI research centre and Cohere. The focus is knowledge management, security and responsible adoption.
Cohere is reported to be in advanced talks to raise $2â€“3B at a valuation of about $20B, up from $7B in September 2025. The round is not confirmed as closed.

Cohere signed a definitive merger agreement to acquire Germany's Aleph Alpha, pending final regulatory approval. Aleph Alpha co-CEO Ilhan Scheer becomes Cohere's COO, and Samuel Weinbach will lead research. Cohere also acquired a Montreal/Berlin pharma-commercial AI startup and signed MOUs with Indra and Multiverse Computing in Spain.
PwC and Cohere announced a global alliance, launching first in Canada, to deploy North and Cohere's models for enterprise clients, including private-cloud, on-prem and air-gapped options.
Columbia announced it will report Q3 2026 results on Oct 29, 2026 at about 4:05pm ET. This gives sellers a timely hook for outreach just before or after the release.

Q2 2026 results beat guidance on international growth and a roughly $78M IEEPA tariff refund (about $62M recognized in earnings). The company updated its full-year 2026 outlook, and the fibre2fashion headline says it raised it.
Executives warned of increased pressure on the US consumer and softer US demand. Excluding the refund, gross margin contracted slightly and SG&A grew in line with sales.
CEO Tim Boyle discussed the $78M tariff refund and how tariffs are affecting the business in a CNBC interview.

GXO Logistics began running Columbia's main European distribution hub in Cambrai, France, under a new 10-year agreement. The agreement covers inbound logistics, storage, fulfillment and outbound distribution. GXO describes it as part of a multi-year plan to strengthen Columbia's European supply chain.

Columbia will report Q3 2026 results on Oct 29, 2026. Current guidance is Q3 EPS of $1.15-1.35 and full-year EPS of $4.45-4.90. Q2 results came out on Jul 30, 2026, and the company updated its full-year outlook then.

Footwear is a key growth priority under the Columbia brand's ACCELERATE strategy. The Spring 2027 wholesale order book points to low-to-mid-single-digit growth, and footwear is expected to grow faster than apparel in 2026.
Columbia released a limited-edition Helvetia II fleece in a print based on the Portland airport carpet, marking 35 years of the Helvetia fleece. It also opened a new store at PDX.
Crusoe raised a $3.9B Series F at a $30.9B valuation to expand AI data centers and modular AI factories.
Crusoe is developing a data center campus in Armstrong County, Texas. The campus is for Google, powered by adjacent West Texas wind, and uses closed-loop liquid cooling.
Crusoe filed for a $4.8B data center campus in Jayton, Texas. Construction is planned to begin at the end of the year.
Crusoe is planning a Phase 3 expansion at its Stargate campus in Abilene, with two new data center buildings.
Crusoe is hiring for senior roles, including Director of Recruiting for Digital Infrastructure and Director of Commercial Operations. The postings suggest the company is scaling its teams.

Crusoe raised a $3.9B Series F at a $30.9B post-money valuation. Atreides, Mubadala and Valor co-led, with Nvidia, Founders Fund, GIC, QIA and TPG also participating. The money will fund the Abilene, TX campus work and expansion of its modular 'Spark' data centers.

Alongside the Series F, Crusoe added three board members: Cloudflare CFO Thomas Seifert, Bill Stein of Primary Digital Infrastructure, and JB Straubel of Redwood Materials. The same source mentions IPO plans, but the snippet gave no detail.
Crusoe signed a multi-year deal with Perplexity. Perplexity will train models on dedicated Nvidia GB300 NVL72 clusters and run production inference on Crusoe Managed Inference.

Thinking Machines Lab signed a $65M annual agreement to serve its open models (Inkling, GLM 5.2 and 5.3, and fine-tuned variants) on Crusoe Managed Inference. The deployment runs on dedicated NVIDIA HGX B200 systems.
Bloomberg reportedly said Crusoe has a five-year, $13B cloud contract with Jane Street. This comes from a secondary blog that relays TechCrunch, so it is not confirmed by the company.
Crusoe reportedly ended a $1.25B agreement for 29 Boom Supersonic Superpower turbines. A spokesperson said its energy plans 'haven't changed' and that it will still use turbines, just not Boom's.
Crusoe pledged $50M in compute credits to a White House AI science initiative. It is also a launch partner for the National Compute Grid.

Newcomer reports Crusoe is on track for about $2B in revenue this year. Separately, Crusoe says Cloud bookings are up more than 20x year over year and Managed Inference has more than $100M in contracted ARR.
Crusoe announced a 1.0 GW campus in Childress, TX with Lancium. It also opened a Spark modular data center factory in Brighton, CO in March, which is older than 90 days.
Databricks announced a new funding round at a $188B valuation, according to Forge Global. Equitybee lists an Aug 2026 round of $5B at a $185B valuation, so the figures differ by source.
Equitybee's funding history lists a $2B debt financing in Feb 2026 and a $5B private equity round in Dec 2025 at a $129B valuation.
Databricks and Microsoft expanded their partnership to bring business context to enterprise AI. Databricks uses Azure Cobalt 100 and plans to adopt Cobalt 200.
EY and Databricks formalised and expanded their partnership in the Netherlands.
Databricks introduced ai_decide, a native AI Function for making fast, low-cost decisions on governed data.
Rimes hired ex-FINRA tech chief Tigran Khrimian as CTO to lead its data platform migration onto Databricks. This is a customer signal, not a Databricks leadership change.
Databricks closed a $5B strategic round (Series L) at a $190B valuation, led by Coatue with Blackstone, MGX and T. Rowe Price. The valuation was $134B in February 2026.
Databricks reported crossing a $7B annualized revenue run-rate, growing more than 80% year over year. It has been free-cash-flow positive and has set no IPO date.

Databricks acquired spreadsheet startup Row Zero to add a live, governed spreadsheet interface to Genie. TechCrunch calls it the company's fourth acquisition of 2026, and Ghodsi said more are planned.
Fox Corporation named Databricks its platform of choice for data, AI apps and agents in a multi-year strategic partnership. Fox will use Lakebase, Genie Code, Unity Gateway and Genie Ontology.

Microsoft and Databricks expanded their decade-long partnership through the 2030s. Databricks will deepen its use of Azure, including Azure Cobalt, and Microsoft will integrate Genie and Unity AI Gateway across its products.
Databricks is actively hiring. a16z's job board lists 895 open roles, and Databricks has current postings for partner marketing (AWS and AI partners) and PR.
ElevenLabs closed a $300M employee tender offer at a $22B valuation. That is double the $11B set in its February Series D, and the tender is a secondary sale rather than new primary capital.
Ashley Kramer joined as ElevenLabs' first Chief Revenue Officer, a newly created role, as the company pushes into enterprise sales.
DXC Technology announced a strategic partnership with ElevenLabs to embed voice AI across enterprise operations, and joint projects are now starting.
ElevenLabs is opening a Singapore office and plans to hire for engineering and sales roles.

ElevenLabs has open enterprise sales roles, such as Enterprise Account Executive for Consumer Brands, and a Chief of Staff role for its Talent organization. Together these point to a sales and recruiting build-out.
ElevenLabs closed a $300M employee tender offer co-led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price at a $22B valuation. That is double the $11B Series D valuation from February 2026.

ElevenLabs launched Eleven v4, a more expressive text-to-speech model, and Eleven v4 Turbo, a low-latency variant for voice agents and real-time use. Both are available in ElevenAgents, ElevenCreative and the API.

ElevenLabs and Universal Music Group announced a multi-year licensing agreement to build an authorized AI music platform. Fans could remix licensed UMG tracks, and the two companies will jointly develop AI audio tools for artists.

ElevenLabs says organizations including Stripe, Deutsche Telekom, SevenRooms, Admiral, Customers Bank, Cadence and the governments of Ukraine and Greece have rolled out ElevenAgents. This is useful as customer proof points.
ElevenLabs launched an 'ElevenLabs for Students' plan. It gives university students in the US, Canada, EU27, Australia and the UK 3 months of free access and a free year of ElevenReader Ultra.

ElevenLabs is actively hiring enterprise go-to-market staff. Open roles include Enterprise Account Executives (consumer brands, strategic, and ElevenProductions in North America), a sports specialist, and a first Product Enablement hire.

Figma announced Specs, a Markdown-based editor for defining a company's design context for AI agents. It also announced code and library integrations, a Payload headless CMS integration, and 20 new MCP partner integrations, including OpenCode. The announcements came at its first Config event in India.
Figma is launching 20 new MCP partner integrations so users can connect coding and AI tools to Figma. It also announced a Payload headless CMS integration.

Figma will report Q3 2026 results after market close on Nov 4, 2026. Q3 revenue guidance is $373â€“375M. A Zacks snippet says the last reported quarter had EPS of $0.08 against a consensus estimate of $0.04.

Figma reportedly acquired the AI startup Common Knowledge, which built Flipbook. The article is undated, so I can't confirm it falls within the last 90 days. Tracxn lists 5 acquisitions by Figma in total.

At its first Config in India, Figma announced Figma Specs (a Markdown editor that defines design language for teams and agents) and a Payload headless CMS integration. It also moved code layers into public beta.
Figma is deepening its India investment with its largest international Config yet. The announcements include an education program, new research, and an MCP partnership with Sarvam.

Figma will report Q3 2026 results after the close on Nov 4, 2026. Q1 2026 revenue was $333.4M, up 46% year over year, with a net loss of $142.4M. Guidance cited on Simply Wall St was raised to $1.422â€“1.428B for full-year 2026 revenue, about 35% growth.
Figma expanded its London office and launched data residency in Japan, which points to international and enterprise expansion.

Figma has many open roles posted in late September and early October 2026. They include AI observability, AI tooling, security, enterprise sales (including Berlin), solutions consulting, and a Director of Data Science.
FIG stock fell about 21% from Aug 26 to Sep 24, 2026, which Tickeron attributes to profit-taking, AI competition concerns and valuation pressure. It closed at $21.49 on Oct 16.
Glean joined OpenAI's new B2B marketplace as a launch partner. Eligible enterprise customers can use part of their OpenAI commitment on Glean.

At Glean GO 2026, Glean reportedly launched a new class of proactive agents, starting with an OnCall Assistant, along with an AI desktop workspace. This comes from a LinkedIn recap, not a Glean primary source. The recap is dated about 3 weeks before today, and I can't pin down the exact date.
Glean has a Team Chat feature that puts teams and AI in one shared chat and dashboard. A product demo video was posted within the last week.

Glean is a launch partner in OpenAI's new B2B marketplace, announced at OpenAI DevDay. Eligible OpenAI enterprise customers can apply part of their OpenAI spend commitment to Glean. Glean paired the news with its AI Gateway governance product.

Glean is promoting Glean AI Gateway, an enterprise control plane that governs AI access across Glean Assistant, external coding tools and custom apps. Glean says its Assistant and Agents run on OpenAI's GPT-6 model family.
Glean has an open Principal Product Marketing Manager role for 'Glean Enterprise Context'. This suggests a go-to-market push around its context, connectors and Enterprise Graph technology.

A Polymarket page says October 2026 secondary-market prints imply a valuation of about $6.9B, slightly below the $7.2B Series F valuation. It also says no new equity round has emerged recently. This is a prediction-market page with unverified figures.
Harvey raised $550M at a $15.5B valuation, co-led by Diffusion and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Reports cite ARR above $400M and more than 3,000 customers.
Harvey is opening a Boston office this fall and is hiring in sales, recruiting, legal engineering and customer success. COO Katie Burke, a former HubSpot executive, is a Boston champion.
Harvey hired 22 Am Law 200 lawyers in H1 2026, more than Anthropic, OpenAI and Legora combined. It also has open GTM roles, such as Head of GTM Strategy & Operations, AMER.
Harvey launched a Pro Bono Program with partner organizations. The partners will deliver AI for pro bono teams and vulnerable justice-system users.
Harvey's site now lists Legal Work Orchestration (legal project management with agents) and Harvey Intake (an in-house legal front door and request management).
Harvey is live in the OpenAI Marketplace as an official launch partner.
Per a Nikkei Asia post, Harvey's CEO says it will open a Japan office in 2027. He also said efficiency gains could pressure the billable-hour model.
Harvey raised $550M at a $15.5B valuation, co-led by Diffusion and Lightspeed. This follows a $200M round at $11B in March 2026 and an $8B valuation in December 2025.
Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan invested US$50M in Harvey, and Harvey announced a deeper commitment to Canada.

Co-founder Winston Weinberg said ARR has passed $400M, up from about $190M in January. Harvey says it has 3,000+ customer organizations, 200,000+ lawyers, and 80% of the Am Law 100. The ARR figure was reported widely but was not in Harvey's own funding announcement.
Harvey is opening a Boston office. It will support existing customers (Ropes & Gray, Mintz, DraftKings, Toast and others) and house sales staff. COO Katie Burke was quoted.
CEO Winston Weinberg told Nikkei that Harvey will open a Japan office in 2027 and target major Japanese law firms and corporate legal departments.
Harvey chose London to lead its pro bono push (City A.M. headline).

Harvey hired 22 Am Law 200 lawyers in six months, more than Anthropic, OpenAI and Legora combined. Many went into ~$220K 'legal engineer' roles. Harvey and Legora together have nearly 600 open roles. Crustdata lists about 1,795 Harvey employees, up 129% year over year.
Harvey published an engineering post on its Connector Library. Users have 100,000+ connections to external tools, with a policy engine governing what agents can access.
Harvey integrated PacerPro docket data into litigation workflows. Its implementation of DeepJudge's Agent Handoff Protocol is entering beta. Both items come from an aggregator and have no firm dates.

Mistral unveiled Mistral Large 4, an open-weight model, which Trending Topics presents as Europe's bid to stay in the AI race.

CERN and Mistral signed a statement of intent for a long-term strategic partnership to build Flare, an AI foundation model for physics. Reuters says Flare will be released to the public on October 27.
Mistral opened a Munich hub for Physics AI and Industrial AI research, working with German industry partners.
Samsung announced a strategic partnership to bring Mistral's AI services into its semiconductor engineering and manufacturing operations.
Cloudera and Mistral announced a strategic partnership on sovereign AI, so enterprises can build AI without exposing sensitive data.
Mistral hired a Senior Corporate Counsel (MENA lead) in Dubai. This points to a Middle East and Africa build-out, and a separate social post mentions Mistral Darija models for Morocco.

Mistral launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4 ('le Chonk'), a roughly 1T-parameter open-weight model aimed at cyber, coding, manufacturing, finance and multimodal work. It was trained on Mistral's own European datacenters. Weights are due to be released on Oct 27.

CERN and Mistral signed a statement of intent for a long-term strategic partnership to build foundation models for scientific discovery, starting with a Large Physics Model for collider physics. No timeline or budget was disclosed.
Samsung Electronics announced a strategic partnership with Mistral to enhance its semiconductor engineering and manufacturing. The snippet was dated only '5 weeks ago', so the date is approximate.

Microsoft and Mistral announced an expanded strategic partnership, backed by a new multibillion-dollar Microsoft commitment to expand Mistral's Europe-based GPU infrastructure. The snippet was dated only '2 months ago'.

Mistral opened a Munich hub for Physics AI and Industrial AI, with applied engineers serving enterprise partners. It is working with BMW on crash simulation and Siemens Energy on industrial AI, and has a research partnership with TU Munich. The hub builds on the Emmi AI acquisition in May 2026.
Mistral acquired design studio New Material, which will form a new 'Solutions Design' group that works with customers on AI deployments. No price was disclosed.

LinkedIn's 2026 French Top Startups list ranks Mistral first, based partly on hiring growth and talent attraction. Separately, research staff made up only 29% of technical staff in H1 2026, which points to a shift toward applied and enterprise engineering.

Peloton launched the Tread Flex, its first foldable and most affordable treadmill. It also announced new AI-powered coaching features for runners, walkers and hikers, and a new partnership with WHOOP.

CNBC reports Peloton is revamping its treadmill line with three new treadmills, including its first folding model, plus new Peloton IQ features. The company is aiming to broaden appeal from casual walkers and hikers to serious runners.
Peloton added a WHOOP partnership to its wellness ecosystem, alongside existing Apple Health, Fitbit and Garmin Connect integrations.
A Pelotonâ€“Google Gemini integration is reportedly live. Members can link their Peloton account in Gemini to find classes and add them to their schedules.
Chief Accounting Officer Saqib Baig notified Peloton on Oct 8, 2026 that he is stepping down to pursue an external opportunity. A separate post says his last day is Nov 27.
Peloton ran a Tread Flex marketing campaign with Miley Cyrus, set to her new single "Bass Persuades".

Chief Accounting Officer Saqib Baig is leaving for an outside opportunity, effective Nov 27, 2026. Peloton has started a search for his successor and says the departure is unrelated to any accounting or disclosure issues.

Peloton launched three treadmills: Tread Flex (its first folding model and its cheapest treadmill), Tread Vision and Tread+ Vision. It also added Peloton IQ AI coaching features for runners, including Run Analysis. Tread Vision became available Oct 1, 2026.

Peloton reported its first full year of positive net income and operating income for FY26 (ended June 30), with $63M net income, $161M operating income and $378M free cash flow. It ended the year with $1.21B cash and $93M net debt. Q4 revenue was about $607.7M, roughly flat.
Peloton expanded its content distribution through a Spotify partnership. More than 1,400 Peloton strength and wellness classes are now available to Spotify Premium subscribers.

Peloton is building a commercial fitness business that sells more durable versions of its equipment to hotels, apartment buildings and gyms. It is also pitching a shift from connected fitness to a 'connected wellness' ecosystem. CNBC reports subscriptions are trending lower and revenue growth is a challenge.
Ramp reportedly raised $1.85B at a $60B valuation. Headlines also say annualized revenue is above $2B and that it is adding AI agent cost controls to its platform.

Ramp launched Ramp Accounts Receivable, an invoice-to-cash product with a free tier. It is available to US single-entity businesses on QuickBooks Online and NetSuite, and other ERP integrations are 'coming soon'.
Ramp and the San Francisco 49ers announced a multi-year partnership aimed at fans, finance leaders and Bay Area businesses.

Ramp has open roles for Senior Channel Partner Manager (Global Advisory/GSI and Strategic Advisory) and Financial Partnerships Manager, International. These suggest it is building out its accounting-firm and advisory channel and its international payments partnerships.

Ramp raised $1.85B at a $60B valuation, co-led by Dragoneer, Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Sands Capital and Avenir. This comes four months after its $44B round. Ramp's press release says annualized revenue is above $2B.
Ramp announced a $750M Series F at a $44B valuation, led by ICONIQ, GIC and Ontario Teachers'. It said total payment volume grew about 170% year over year in March 2026.

Ramp launched Ramp Accounts Receivable, an invoice-to-cash product, so it now covers both payables and receivables. It is available to US single-entity businesses with QuickBooks Online and NetSuite integrations.
Ramp launched its corporate card, expense, bill pay and accounting automation platform in the UK. This is its first major expansion outside North America, following a Canada launch in July.
Ramp acquired travel platform Juno and payments platform Billhop. Billhop gave it payment licenses in the UK and Sweden, which supported the UK launch.
ServiceTitan announced a strategic partnership with Ramp. Contractors get AI bill pay and Ramp-powered expense cards that sync into ServiceTitan jobs.
Ramp opened stablecoin accounts and payments to customers.
Ramp and the San Francisco 49ers announced a multi-year partnership. The search result gave no date.

Ramp is pushing into AI agents for procurement, accounting and payments, and into token spend management. It has also launched Router.com and Glass, plus an AI operating system for accounting firms (Stack). Capital One's $5.15B acquisition of competitor Brex earlier this year changes the competitive landscape.

Rippling is posting a General Manager, Mergers & Acquisitions - Recruiting role. The role owns revenue, cash flow, expenses and client relationships, which may point to an acquisition-led growth push in recruiting. That reading is my inference from the posting, not something the posting states.
Rippling is actively hiring sales roles, including Strategic Enterprise Account Executive and New Logo AE NAMER (ESB). That suggests it is expanding go-to-market capacity in both enterprise and SMB.
